Japanese raisin tree extract comes from *Hovenia dulcis* (also called the oriental raisin tree). It is `traditionally used in East Asia for hangover relief and liver support`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXGB8yyvjLW7j8i8XzoFnXxEnTqS2Je0_l9WR1iuuITI3GZHKTyQgGE8GS04VvVTbZsbxxPtdNmBtwevFbz-ShYLwYhIfpA4OfG_KU7Tefj1E3X9KgAHKSC5ReltIRsAInPA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXtAeF2mCvAXVqIo3cRbz8LuxieE9CbyKeF2hLeqpu6ByDTBQqENjlJuTlS28r0KEsU5SxUbfJj6FACgSNX6FlFYW9Mj0oVkR08CgUGgopLHL3tKoEwn8XSJ33kpP1wAZMD-TWby88p_JzYIVnwFrdnBA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXxR3K1fV1o66M02v301FPVZ9rZXaDwoiT1GMpIoIoAcfcAEtinda_HSANdq7nOSCNtr0LSVAoj4FeN2WwuVXTtlUKbisus6IwxL8zpHDf16mjr820wQnz4Y9SvtAzpRJmVLvVxQ)

### Key Compounds & Uses

- **Active compounds:** Contains dihydromyricetin (DHM), flavonoids like quercetin and myricetin, and hodulcine (a compound that temporarily blocks sweetness perception on the tongue).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXxR3K1fV1o66M02v301FPVZ9rZXaDwoiT1GMpIoIoAcfcAEtinda_HSANdq7nOSCNtr0LSVAoj4FeN2WwuVXTtlUKbisus6IwxL8zpHDf16mjr820wQnz4Y9SvtAzpRJmVLvVxQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXtAeF2mCvAXVqIo3cRbz8LuxieE9CbyKeF2hLeqpu6ByDTBQqENjlJuTlS28r0KEsU5SxUbfJj6FACgSNX6FlFYW9Mj0oVkR08CgUGgopLHL3tKoEwn8XSJ33kpP1wAZMD-TWby88p_JzYIVnwFrdnBA)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ALPGMLh_CQs&t=513)
- **Hangover & liver support:** Used in folk medicine and supplements to help with alcohol metabolism and hangover symptoms. - **Plant parts used:** The sweet, raisin-like fruit stalks (peduncles), seeds, and leaves are used in teas, extracts, and supplements.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXtAeF2mCvAXVqIo3cRbz8LuxieE9CbyKeF2hLeqpu6ByDTBQqENjlJuTlS28r0KEsU5SxUbfJj6FACgSNX6FlFYW9Mj0oVkR08CgUGgopLHL3tKoEwn8XSJ33kpP1wAZMD-TWby88p_JzYIVnwFrdnBA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF11TRx42zfVPPaOjyxg0-Ahi9qs110jI2fBP9GAhTX8DRlCtFM9a2puGS8K4v7Sy87yjZkeTgPVw91nn-Ck8_Opt77mHNlx5kp3BEGjaHGdZHnmb1UyCxRcNAjrjuFGwMrjjupRLzed9Ys4ufEZsde0lVvcRLcaGRElnt-Ws85omiCC0_d-2XwUbKqH5U1EO7ADRE6nLjygqZ)

- **Teas & liquid extracts:** Sold as roasted herbal tea bags (like Ssanggye Tea) or concentrated fruit extract drinks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF17d2xUjD_ei4Hgtu8oEG6d50l5GheCeoU5YxvSQnrXH_mcgSLW3xMn3nDYTu-TmVMyfYzXVKlpyyAOcQstV6iqVjXv1__EpXSZmi3PN5s6ENIXnfJW1w-mohYRL7i3ACxyPZlUnh03mjX3xrM6JRepr1tDX6w-kYS3tX36Lq_eTshXc2HIwMPWkkk0AE6Mn6P3k)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7321098402065862308&ibp=oshop)

Possible side effects include mild digestive upset or lower blood sugar.
